intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni boat decorated with flowers and lanterns, exclusively chartered for two. Drift across the Indian Ocean as the sun melts into the horizon, sipping chilled champagne and enjoying a curated platter of local and international canapés. The crew captures romantic photos and the captain navigates to the best sunset vantage points away from resort crowds.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll, around Veligandu or Baros Island

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Join a guided half-day snorkeling safari to three of the Maldives' most vibrant coral gardens and reef systems. Swim alongside sea turtles, reef sharks, manta rays, and thousands of tropical fish in crystal-clear turquoise lagoons. A marine biologist guide explains the ecosystem, and the experience includes snorkel gear, underwater cameras, and a light tropical lunch on a sandbank.
experiences.location: South Ari Atoll, near Maamigili and Rangali Island

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two
experiences.description: Descend beneath the ocean surface to dine in one of the world's most iconic underwater restaurants, surrounded by panoramic views of the reef teeming with marine life. Enjoy a five-course tasting menu featuring Maldivian lobster, fresh tuna, and exotic tropical desserts, paired with fine wines. Candlelight, soft music, and gliding fish create an unmatched honeymoon dining experience.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, Alimatha, South Ari Atoll

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk
experiences.description: After dark, walk along a secluded stretch of beach where the waves glow electric blue due to bioluminescent phytoplankton. A local naturalist guide leads the experience, explaining the rare natural phenomenon while you and your partner wade through glowing surf and stargaze under one of the world's least light-polluted skies. Includes a private beach picnic setup with tropical fruits and sparkling water.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class & Cultural Village Tour
experiences.description: Visit a local inhabited island to experience authentic Maldivian culture beyond the resort bubble. Tour a traditional fishing village, visit a centuries-old Friday mosque, and participate in a hands-on cooking class where a local family teaches you to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and hedhikaa snacks. End with a shared meal and a short lesson in traditional Bodu Beru drumming.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - arrival day
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - arrival day
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. Complete immigration and customs formalities. Arrange speedboat or local ferry transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and enjoy a welcome drink at the resort. Take a short stroll along the beachfront to soak in the night ambiance.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable - travel day
meals.lunch: Not applicable - travel day
meals.dinner: Grab a quick affordable bite at the airport food court before boarding your transfer, or enjoy a light late-night snack at the resort cafe upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Keep all travel documents handy. Exchange some currency to Maldivian Rufiyaa (MVR) at the airport for local purchases. Confirm resort transfer in advance to avoid extra costs. Rest well for the exciting days ahead.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early and watch the stunning sunrise from the beachfront. Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort. Take a relaxed walk along the shoreline to familiarize yourself with the resort surroundings and spot early morning marine life in the shallow lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort's house reef for your first snorkeling session. Explore the vibrant coral gardens and spot colorful reef fish, sea turtles, and possibly rays. Borrow or rent budget snorkeling gear from the resort. Return to the beach and relax under a palm tree with a coconut drink.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic sunset walk along the beach with your partner. Dine at the resort's more affordable beachside casual dining option. Stargaze from the beach after dinner - the Maldives offers spectacular clear night skies away from city light pollution.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet included with stay or opt for a light continental spread at the resort cafe
meals.lunch: Pack a simple picnic from the resort's takeaway counter or enjoy an affordable local-style rice and curry at the resort's budget dining option
meals.dinner: Beachside casual dinner at the resort - opt for grilled fish or local curry dishes which are typically more affordable than imported menu items

day_by_day.notes: Apply reef-safe sunscreen to protect both your skin and the coral ecosystem. Stay hydrated throughout the day. Ask resort staff about free or low-cost snorkeling spots near the house reef.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget-friendly group snorkeling excursion organized by the resort or a local operator. Explore a nearby coral reef known for abundant marine biodiversity. Look out for parrotfish, clownfish, moray eels, and vibrant coral formations.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby local island by public ferry or a shared day trip to experience authentic Maldivian village life. Explore the narrow streets, visit a local mosque (dress modestly), browse small shops for affordable souvenirs like woven mats and dried fish products.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Enjoy a romantic couple's evening with a homemade-style cocktail or mocktail at the resort bar. Watch the sunset together from the resort pier. Have a quiet dinner at the resort.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at the resort - fresh tropical fruits, toast, and local tea
meals.lunch: Eat at a local island cafe or 'tea shop' (sai hotaa) on the visited local island - incredibly affordable and authentic. Try mas huni (tuna and coconut) with roshi flatbread
meals.dinner: Resort dinner - choose a set menu or daily special which tends to be more cost-effective than ordering a la carte

day_by_day.notes: Public ferries between islands are extremely budget-friendly (as low as $1-2 USD). Dress conservatively when visiting local islands - cover shoulders and knees out of respect for local culture. Carry small denomination MVR for local purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session at the house reef during high tide for the best visibility and marine activity. This is a free activity available right off the beach. Practice identifying different fish species using a waterproof fish ID card available at the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Participate in a resort-organized or locally-led dolphin watching cruise. Many budget operators offer shared boat trips at a fraction of private tour costs. The waters around the Maldives are home to spinner dolphins that frequently play in boat wakes.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic dinner setup on the beach - ask the resort in advance if they offer an affordable beach dining setup for couples. Alternatively, dine at the resort restaurant and take a moonlit walk along the shore afterwards.

meals.breakfast: Fresh fruit platter with yogurt and granola at the resort
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort pool bar - sandwiches or wraps are usually more affordable options
meals.dinner: Special beach dinner or resort restaurant - splurge slightly on this romantic evening meal as a honeymoon treat while staying within budget by skipping alcohol

day_by_day.notes: Book dolphin watching cruise in advance through the resort or local operators for group rates. Best dolphin sightings are typically at dusk. Bring a light jacket for the boat trip as evenings can get breezy on the water.

day_by_day.morning: Take a guided snorkeling tour to a sandbank or a more distant reef. Many resorts organize shared group tours that are significantly cheaper than private charters. Look for manta rays, which are commonly spotted in Maldivian waters in March.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax at the resort beach and try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) or kayaking - often included in resort amenities or available at low hourly rental rates. Explore the lagoon at your own pace and enjoy the crystal-clear turquoise waters.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a cultural show or Boduberu (traditional Maldivian drumming and dance) performance if organized by the resort. Enjoy a casual dinner and share stories of the day's adventures.

meals.breakfast: Maldivian-style breakfast - fihunu mas (grilled fish) with roshi bread and black tea, available at local-style resort options
meals.lunch: Picnic-style lunch packed from the resort takeaway - sandwiches, fruits, and water for the snorkeling trip
meals.dinner: Casual resort dinner - try the catch of the day which is fresh, local, and usually well-priced

day_by_day.notes: March is an excellent time for manta ray sightings. Ask resort staff about current manta ray hotspots. SUP and kayaking are great low-cost ways to explore the lagoon independently. Boduberu performances are a wonderful cultural experience unique to the Maldives.

day_by_day.morning: Spend a peaceful morning at the resort's private beach. Practice mindful relaxation - read a book, journal your honeymoon memories, or simply float in the warm Indian Ocean. The Maldives is perfect for slow, intentional mornings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a budget snorkeling trip to a nearby shipwreck or artificial reef if available in the area. Shipwreck snorkeling offers a unique experience with different marine life than coral reefs. Alternatively, explore a different section of the house reef.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktail hour at the resort bar - enjoy one special couple's cocktail as a treat. Walk to the end of the resort pier for panoramic ocean views as the sun dips below the horizon. Early dinner and a romantic evening in your beachfront room.

meals.breakfast: Continental breakfast at the resort - croissants, fresh juice, and coffee
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort - fresh salad with grilled tuna, a Maldivian staple
meals.dinner: Resort dinner - opt for the set menu or buffet option if available for better value

day_by_day.notes: A slow day is essential on a 13-day trip to avoid burnout. Embrace the island pace of life. Check with the resort about any complimentary evening activities or entertainment planned for guests.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint of the trip - celebrate with an early morning snorkeling session at the best part of the house reef. Take underwater photos if you have a waterproof camera or a housing for your phone. Document the incredible marine biodiversity you've encountered.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a local ferry to a nearby inhabited island for a half-day cultural exploration. Visit the island's harbor, watch local fishermen bring in their catch, and explore the island's small market. Purchase local handicrafts as affordable souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a special mid-trip romantic dinner. Request a table with the best view of the ocean. Share a dessert and reminisce about the first half of your honeymoon.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast to fuel the active day ahead
meals.lunch: Eat at a local island restaurant - hedhikaa (Maldivian short eats/snacks) and tea is an extremely affordable and delicious local meal option
meals.dinner: Slightly elevated resort dinner to mark the midpoint celebration - choose one special dish each and keep it meaningful rather than expensive

day_by_day.notes: Local ferry schedules should be checked the day before to plan the afternoon trip efficiently. Hedhikaa snacks at local tea shops typically cost less than $5 for a satisfying meal. Carry your passport or resort ID when visiting local islands.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning fishing excursion - join a shared traditional Maldivian hand-line fishing trip. This is an authentic experience and budget-friendly when done on a shared group basis. Catch your own breakfast if lucky!
day_by_day.afternoon: If fish were caught during the morning, arrange with the resort kitchen to cook them for a special lunch. Spend the afternoon relaxing at the beach, swimming, and enjoying the resort's facilities. Try the resort's swimming pool if available.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a beachside bonfire if the resort organizes one, or find a quiet spot on the beach for stargazing. The Maldives' remote location means incredibly dark skies and brilliant star visibility. Look for the Milky Way on clear nights.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-fishing breakfast - toast, banana, and tea
meals.lunch: Freshly cooked catch of the morning if successful, or a simple resort lunch - grilled fish with rice and salad
meals.dinner: Casual resort dinner - enjoy the relaxed atmosphere after a full day of activities

day_by_day.notes: Fishing trips are best in the early morning before the heat of the day. Shared fishing excursions cost a fraction of private charters. Even if no fish are caught, the experience of traditional Maldivian fishing is memorable and culturally enriching.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicated snorkeling exploration day - spend the entire morning at the house reef or a nearby reef, taking your time to observe marine behavior. Look for octopus hiding in coral crevices, nudibranchs, and schooling fish.
day_by_day.afternoon: Beach relaxation and water activities. Try floating in the lagoon with a snorkel mask just below the surface to observe marine life from above - a meditative and peaceful experience. Build sandcastles, collect shells (do not take live shells), or simply nap under a palm.
day_by_day.evening: Dress up for a romantic dinner - even at a budget resort, dressing nicely and making the evening special costs nothing extra. Request a corner table or a special setup if the resort accommodates such requests. Exchange heartfelt messages or letters as a honeymoon tradition.

meals.breakfast: Tropical fruit breakfast - papaya, mango, pineapple, and coconut water
meals.lunch: Beach picnic with resort-prepared sandwiches and fresh coconut
meals.dinner: Resort dinner with a romantic atmosphere - choose dishes that are locally sourced for better value and freshness

day_by_day.notes: Writing letters to each other during a honeymoon is a beautiful tradition that creates lasting memories. The Maldives' warm, calm lagoons are perfect for effortless floating and relaxation. March weather is generally excellent with calm seas.

day_by_day.morning: Join a group snorkeling trip to a coral garden known for sea turtles. The Maldives has abundant green and hawksbill turtle populations. Swimming alongside a sea turtle is a life-changing experience and a highlight of any Maldives trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's spa for a budget-friendly treatment - opt for a shorter 30-minute massage instead of a full package to experience the luxury without the full cost. Many resorts offer promotional rates for shorter treatments. Relax by the pool afterwards.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset photography session - capture the stunning Maldivian sunset together as a couple. The beachfront and resort pier offer perfect vantage points. Enjoy a light dinner and review your favorite photos of the trip so far.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast to prepare for the active morning
meals.lunch: Post-snorkeling light lunch at the resort - fresh salad and grilled fish
meals.dinner: Light and affordable resort dinner - soup, bread, and a main course

day_by_day.notes: Maintain a respectful distance from sea turtles - do not touch or chase them. Observe from a distance to avoid disturbing their natural behavior. Spa treatments should be booked in advance. Look for any resort promotions or honeymoon packages that may include complimentary spa access.

day_by_day.morning: Last major snorkeling day - revisit your favorite snorkeling spot from the trip. Take final underwater photos and videos. Spend time truly appreciating the incredible marine ecosystem you've had the privilege of exploring throughout the trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Souvenir shopping at the resort gift shop or on a nearby local island. Look for affordable authentic Maldivian crafts - lacquerware, woven products, and local jewelry. Budget wisely and prioritize meaningful items over quantity.
day_by_day.evening: Special penultimate evening dinner - this is a good night to slightly splurge on a memorable meal. Choose the best dining option available at the resort and enjoy a long, leisurely dinner celebrating your honeymoon.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast - enjoy a relaxed, unhurried morning meal
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort or local island if visiting for shopping
meals.dinner: Best resort dining experience of the trip - order thoughtfully to balance splurging and budget. Share a dessert to celebrate the near-end of a wonderful honeymoon

day_by_day.notes: Local island markets offer far better prices on souvenirs than resort gift shops. Lacquerware and woven palm leaf products are traditional Maldivian crafts worth purchasing. Avoid buying coral, shells, or any marine products as souvenirs - these are often illegally harvested.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning snorkeling session at the house reef - say goodbye to the colorful fish and coral that have been your companions throughout the trip. Take a last swim in the warm Indian Ocean and collect mental snapshots of the breathtaking underwater world.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon relaxing at the beach and pool. Reflect on the incredible experiences of the past 12 days. Write in a travel journal, organize photos, or simply sit together and soak in the last full day in paradise.
day_by_day.evening: Final romantic dinner at the resort - make it special with a beachside table if possible. Watch the last Maldivian sunset of the trip together. Take a final moonlit walk along the beach and collect the last beautiful memories of your honeymoon.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast - enjoy every bite knowing it's the last full day
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort pool bar or beach - keep it simple and relaxed
meals.dinner: Final farewell dinner at the resort - order your favorite dishes from the trip and toast to a wonderful honeymoon with a special drink

day_by_day.notes: Begin packing non-essential items in the evening to make the next morning smoother. Confirm departure transfer arrangements with the resort. Settle any outstanding resort bills in the evening to avoid a rushed checkout. Leave a thank-you note for the resort staff who made your honeymoon special.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for one last sunrise on the beachfront - a peaceful and emotional farewell to the Maldives. Take a final walk along the beach, dip your feet in the lagoon, and breathe in the fresh ocean air. Complete checkout formalities at the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrange resort transfer to Velana International Airport. Arrive at the airport with sufficient time for check-in and immigration. Browse the airport duty-free shops for any last-minute affordable souvenirs. Reflect on the incredible 13-day honeymoon adventure.
day_by_day.evening: Depart from the Maldives carrying beautiful memories of snorkeling adventures, romantic sunsets, turquoise lagoons, and a honeymoon that will be cherished for a lifetime.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast - enjoy a full meal before the journey home
meals.lunch: Airport food court or a light meal before boarding - budget-friendly options are available at the airport
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or at connecting airport depending on departure time and routing

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before departure for the speedboat or ferry transfer to the airport, plus check-in time. Keep all receipts for any duty-free purchases. Ensure all souvenirs comply with customs regulations of your home country. The Maldives has strict regulations against taking out coral, shells, and marine products.

day_by_day.morning: N/A - Travel day
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A - Travel day
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Clear immigration, collect luggage, and meet the Aegean Bliss Resort transfer representative. Board the resort's speedboat or seaplane transfer (depending on resort distance). Check in to your Beachfront accommodation, receive a welcome drink and flower lei. Do a brief orientation of the resort and settle into your room.

meals.breakfast: On the flight
meals.lunch: On the flight or at the airport
meals.dinner: Light welcome snack/room service at the resort upon arrival — try the resort's signature Maldivian short eats platter and fresh tropical juice

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light — you're arriving late at night. Confirm your transfer booking with the resort before departure. Pack a small carry-on with essentials in case checked luggage is delayed. Exchange some USD at the airport for small tips.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely start. Take your first walk along your private beachfront and watch the sunrise over the Indian Ocean. Enjoy a full buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant, soaking in the turquoise lagoon views. Explore the resort grounds, locate the water sports center, spa, and dining venues.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort's house reef for your first snorkeling session directly from the beach. Explore the colorful coral formations and spot reef fish, turtles, and rays in the shallow lagoon. Rent snorkel gear from the water sports center if not included. Return to the beachfront for sunbathing and relaxation. Enjoy a refreshing coconut on the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset from your beachfront villa's private deck. Head to the resort's main bar for a pre-dinner cocktail. Dine at the resort's signature overwater or beachfront restaurant for a romantic first proper dinner.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — fresh tropical fruits, eggs made to order, pastries, and local Maldivian dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut)
meals.lunch: Casual beachside grill or pool bar — grilled fish sandwich, fresh salad, and a mocktail or local soft drink
meals.dinner: Resort's signature restaurant — set menu or à la carte; try grilled lobster or fresh catch of the day with a glass of house wine

day_by_day.notes: This is your recovery and orientation day. Don't over-schedule. Apply reef-safe sunscreen — it's required at most Maldivian resorts to protect coral. Ask the water sports desk about upcoming snorkeling excursions and book the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari for later in the week.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a guided sunrise yoga session on the beach or overwater deck (check resort schedule). Follow with a nourishing breakfast. Visit the resort's spa to book couples treatments for later in the trip. Spend the mid-morning lounging by the infinity pool with views of the lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Book the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — a guided half-day excursion to three of the Maldives' most vibrant coral gardens. Snorkel alongside expert marine biologists, spot sea turtles, reef sharks, manta rays, and schools of tropical fish. The safari typically includes equipment, refreshments, and a light snack on the boat.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort refreshed. Rinse off and relax on your beachfront. As the sun sets, head to the resort bar for sundowners. Enjoy a romantic candlelit dinner for two on the beach — arrange this in advance with the resort concierge for a special setup with lanterns and flower petals.

meals.breakfast: Light and healthy at the resort — açaí bowl, fresh juice, yogurt parfait, and Maldivian roshi (flatbread) with tuna curry
meals.lunch: Packed snack box provided on the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — sandwiches, fruit, and water
meals.dinner: Private candlelit beach dinner arranged by the resort — grilled seafood platter, tropical dessert, and a bottle of mid-range wine or sparkling water

day_by_day.notes: Book the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari at least 24 hours in advance through the resort's activities desk. Bring an underwater camera or GoPro for the snorkeling excursion. Wear a rash guard for sun protection during the half-day on the water.

day_by_day.morning: Start the morning with breakfast at the resort followed by a couples spa session — opt for a traditional Maldivian coconut oil massage or a signature couples' treatment. The spa experience is deeply relaxing and sets a luxurious tone for the day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a kayak or stand-up paddleboard (SUP) out on the calm lagoon — equipment is often included or available at low cost from the water sports center. Paddle around the island's perimeter and enjoy the crystal-clear water from above. Return for a dip in the pool and a light afternoon snack.
day_by_day.evening: This evening, embark on the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — board a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni boat decorated with flowers and lanterns, exclusively for the two of you. Sail into the golden sunset with champagne, canapés, and the sound of gentle waves. This is a quintessential honeymoon experience.

meals.breakfast: Indulgent breakfast at the resort — eggs benedict, fresh tropical fruit platter, freshly squeezed juices, and Maldivian hedhikaa (local snacks)
meals.lunch: Pool bar or beach shack — fish tacos, a light pasta, or a fresh salad with iced tea
meals.dinner: After the dhoni cruise, dine at the resort's overwater restaurant — try the tasting menu with local seafood, finishing with a coconut panna cotta dessert

day_by_day.notes: Book the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise well in advance as it's a popular experience, especially for honeymooners. Bring a light wrap or shawl for the cruise as it can get breezy on the water after sunset. The champagne is typically included — confirm dietary preferences with the operator beforehand.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, indulgent morning — order in-room breakfast or enjoy it on your private beachfront terrace. Spend the morning reading, swimming in the lagoon, or simply doing nothing. This is your true 'honeymoon slow morning.'
day_by_day.afternoon: Join the Maldivian Cooking Class & Cultural Village Tour — take a boat to a local inhabited island and experience authentic Maldivian culture beyond the resort. Learn to cook traditional dishes like garudhiya (fish broth), rihaakuru (fish paste), and fresh roshi flatbread. Tour the village, visit the local mosque (dress modestly), and browse handmade crafts.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort with newfound appreciation for local culture. Freshen up and enjoy a relaxed dinner at the resort's casual dining venue, perhaps trying the dishes you learned to cook during the class.

meals.breakfast: In-room dining or private terrace breakfast — continental spread with fresh fruits, pastries, and local Maldivian tea
meals.lunch: Included as part of the Maldivian Cooking Class — you'll eat what you cook! Authentic local flavors in a traditional setting
meals.dinner: Resort's casual dining restaurant — Maldivian-inspired menu; try the local fish curry, roshi, and fresh coconut dessert, paired with a mocktail or local soft drink

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly for the local island visit — cover shoulders and knees out of respect for the Muslim community. The cooking class is a wonderful cultural immersion experience and great for couples. Purchase locally made souvenirs directly from artisans to support the community.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning dolphin-watching boat trip — ask the resort to arrange a sunrise dolphin cruise. Spinner dolphins are commonly spotted in Maldivian waters in the early morning. Return for a hearty breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend a leisurely afternoon at the resort's infinity pool with cocktails and a good book. Alternatively, try a beginner scuba diving discover session at the resort's dive center — perfect for those who want to take snorkeling to the next level. The house reef offers excellent beginner dive conditions.
day_by_day.evening: This evening, experience the magical Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk — after dark, walk along a secluded stretch of beach where the waves glow electric blue due to bioluminescent plankton. This otherworldly natural phenomenon is one of the Maldives' most romantic and unforgettable experiences.

meals.breakfast: Hearty buffet at the resort after the early dolphin cruise — load up on protein with eggs, fresh fish, and tropical fruits
meals.lunch: Poolside dining — club sandwich, fresh ceviche, or a light wrap with fresh lemonade
meals.dinner: Pre-bioluminescent walk dinner at the resort's beachfront restaurant — grilled catch of the day, vegetable stir-fry, and a shared dessert platter

day_by_day.notes: The bioluminescent phenomenon is best experienced on darker nights, ideally around a new moon. Confirm with the resort or tour operator about the best timing. Do not use torches or phone flashlights during the walk as it disrupts the natural glow. Wear comfortable sandals for the beach walk.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint of the trip — take a relaxed morning. Sleep in, enjoy breakfast on your terrace, and reflect on the first week. Take a slow swim in the lagoon and practice mindfulness on the beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's water sports offerings — try windsurfing, jet skiing, or a glass-bottom boat tour to observe marine life without getting wet. Alternatively, rent snorkel gear and revisit the house reef to see how your marine identification skills have improved since Day 2.
day_by_day.evening: Treat yourselves to the resort's weekly cultural evening or Maldivian traditional show (check resort schedule) — featuring bodu beru drumming, traditional dance, and local storytelling. Enjoy dinner at the resort's main restaurant during or after the show.

meals.breakfast: Late breakfast on your private terrace — order from the in-room dining menu; tropical smoothie bowl, eggs your way, and fresh-baked bread
meals.lunch: Beach grill — BBQ fish skewers, grilled corn, coleslaw, and a fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Main resort restaurant during the cultural evening — international buffet with Maldivian specialties; try the freshly grilled tuna and coconut-based desserts

day_by_day.notes: This is a great day to review photos, organize memories, and plan any remaining bookings for the second week. Check with the concierge about the Underwater Restaurant Dinner — book it now if you haven't already, as it requires advance reservation.

day_by_day.morning: Join an early morning guided snorkeling trip to a nearby sandbank — a pristine white sand island surrounded by shallow turquoise water. Snorkel around the sandbank's edges for excellent marine life sightings, then relax on the deserted sandbar.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for lunch. Spend the afternoon at the spa — book a second couples treatment, perhaps a Javanese lulur scrub, a hot stone massage, or a hydrating facial. Indulge fully in the luxury experience.
day_by_day.evening: Casual and relaxed evening — enjoy cocktails at the overwater bar as the sun sets. Dine at the resort's casual restaurant or order a romantic in-room dinner on your private beachfront terrace under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the sandbank trip — granola, yogurt, banana, and coffee to go
meals.lunch: Post-snorkeling lunch at the resort — fresh fish tacos, a green salad, and fresh lime soda
meals.dinner: In-room or terrace dining — order the resort's seafood platter for two, a bottle of mid-range rosé, and a chocolate fondant for dessert

day_by_day.notes: Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and plenty of water for the sandbank excursion. Sandbanks offer no shade, so time your visit in the early morning before the heat peaks. The spa is a highlight — book the longest treatment package available within mid-range budget for best value.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for a sunrise fishing trip — a traditional Maldivian experience where you fish using handlines from a small boat. Catch-and-cook is sometimes offered. Return to the resort for a late breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore a nearby uninhabited island by speedboat — many resorts offer half-day private island picnics. Arrive on a deserted island with a packed picnic hamper, snorkel gear, and beach games. Swim, snorkel, and enjoy total privacy in paradise.
day_by_day.evening: Tonight is the highlight dining experience — the Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two. Descend beneath the ocean surface and dine in one of the world's most iconic underwater restaurants, surrounded by a panoramic view of the reef and marine life. An unforgettable, once-in-a-lifetime romantic dinner.

meals.breakfast: Late resort buffet breakfast after the fishing trip — fresh fruits, pastries, Maldivian fish curry, and freshly brewed coffee
meals.lunch: Private island picnic — packed hamper with sandwiches, fruit, cheese, crackers, and chilled beverages arranged by the resort
meals.dinner: Underwater Restaurant — multi-course set menu (typically included in the booking); expect fresh seafood, premium ingredients, and a curated wine or mocktail pairing

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant is a premium experience — confirm the booking, dress code (smart casual), and dietary requirements well in advance. This is the most special dining experience of the trip and a perfect honeymoon memory. Take photos before descending — phones may not be permitted inside.

day_by_day.morning: Recovery and relaxation morning after the late dinner. Sleep in and enjoy a slow breakfast. Take a gentle swim in the lagoon and spend time journaling or reading on the beach hammock.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's marine biologist or conservation center (if available) to learn about coral restoration and reef conservation efforts. Many Maldivian resorts have coral nursery programs where guests can plant a coral fragment — a meaningful and lasting contribution to the ecosystem.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a resort-organized stargazing session on the beach — the Maldives, far from light pollution, offers extraordinary views of the Milky Way. Lie on beach mats with a guide pointing out constellations. Follow with a quiet dinner at the resort.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely in-room breakfast — fresh fruit, yogurt, toast with local jam, and herbal tea
meals.lunch: Pool bar — grilled chicken wrap, sweet potato fries, and a fresh mango smoothie
meals.dinner: Resort's casual beachfront restaurant — wood-fired pizza or pasta, a shared starter of bruschetta, and gelato for dessert

day_by_day.notes: The coral planting experience is often available for a small fee and provides a certificate of adoption — a wonderful honeymoon memento. Check with the resort's marine center for scheduling. Stargazing is best on clear, moonless nights — confirm conditions with the concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Final full snorkeling day — revisit your favorite spots from the Coral Garden Safari or explore a new section of the house reef. By now you'll recognize fish species and feel confident in the water. Bring an underwater camera to capture your best shots.
day_by_day.afternoon: Shopping and souvenir afternoon — visit the resort boutique for locally made crafts, lacquerware, and Maldivian gifts. Alternatively, arrange a trip to the nearest local island market for more authentic and affordable souvenirs. Pack and organize any items you've collected during the trip.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic private dinner on the beach — arrange through the concierge for a special setup: a table for two on the sand, lanterns, flower petals, and a personalized menu. Celebrate the near-end of your honeymoon with a meaningful and intimate evening.

meals.breakfast: Full resort buffet — make the most of the spread; fresh seafood, tropical fruits, pastries, and a freshly made omelette
meals.lunch: Beachside casual — fish and chips, coleslaw, and a cold beer or fresh juice
meals.dinner: Private beach dinner arranged by the resort — personalized 3-course menu with champagne or sparkling water; end with a custom dessert with a honeymoon message

day_by_day.notes: This is your second-to-last full day — make it count. Arrange the private beach dinner at least 2 days in advance. Collect any certificates from coral planting or dive courses. Begin thinking about packing — leave tomorrow free for final relaxation.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in paradise — wake up early one last time to watch the sunrise from the beach. Take a slow, reflective walk along the shoreline. Swim in the lagoon and say goodbye to the underwater world with one last snorkel at the house reef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in a final spa treatment — a relaxing foot massage or express facial to feel refreshed for the journey home. Return to your room to begin packing. Enjoy the resort's facilities one last time — pool, beach, overwater bar.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at the resort's finest restaurant — splurge slightly on this last dinner. Order your favorite dishes from the week, share a dessert, and toast to your honeymoon with a glass of champagne or sparkling juice. Reflect on your favorite memories of the trip.

meals.breakfast: Final resort buffet breakfast — savor every bite; fresh tropical fruits, Maldivian mas huni, eggs, and freshly brewed coffee
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch — Caesar salad, a club sandwich, and a fresh coconut
meals.dinner: Resort's finest restaurant — splurge on a special farewell meal; opt for the chef's tasting menu or a seafood feast with a shared dessert and champagne toast

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your departure transfer with the resort concierge today — verify speedboat or seaplane timing for Day 13. Settle any outstanding resort charges. Leave a gratuity for exceptional staff. Back up all your photos tonight. Pack your snorkel gear and any wet items separately.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — enjoy one last breakfast at the resort. Take a final walk on the beach, collect a small shell or photograph as a keepsake. Check out of your Beachfront accommodation and store luggage with the concierge. Spend remaining time at the pool or beach before transfer.
day_by_day.afternoon: Board the resort transfer (speedboat or seaplane) to Velana International Airport. Arrive with ample time for check-in and security. Browse the airport's duty-free shops for last-minute Maldivian souvenirs — local honey, spices, or handicrafts. Board your departure flight.
day_by_day.evening: Departure — carry the memories of 13 magical days in the Maldives as you fly home. Reflect on the snorkeling adventures, romantic dinners, bioluminescent beaches, and the endless turquoise horizon that defined your honeymoon.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — enjoy your favorites one last time; fresh tropical fruits, pastries, and a long cup of coffee on the terrace
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or café — light meal before the flight; sandwiches, salads, or local Maldivian short eats at the airport lounge
meals.dinner: On the flight home

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight for the resort transfer and airport procedures, especially if traveling by seaplane (which has its own check-in terminal). Keep your passport, boarding pass, and valuables in your carry-on. Declare any food items purchased locally at customs. Safe travels — congratulations on your honeymoon!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni boat decorated with flowers and lanterns, exclusively chartered for two. Drift across the Indian Ocean as the sun melts into the horizon, sipping chilled champagne and enjoying a curated platter of local and international canapés. The crew captures romantic photos and the captain navigates to the best sunset vantage points away from resort crowds.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll, around Veligandu or Baros Island

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Join a guided half-day snorkeling safari to three of the Maldives' most vibrant coral gardens and reef systems. Swim alongside sea turtles, reef sharks, manta rays, and thousands of tropical fish in crystal-clear turquoise lagoons. A marine biologist guide explains the ecosystem, and the experience includes snorkel gear, underwater cameras, and a light tropical lunch on a sandbank.
experiences.location: South Ari Atoll, near Maamigili and Rangali Island

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two
experiences.description: Descend beneath the ocean surface to dine in one of the world's most iconic underwater restaurants, surrounded by panoramic views of the reef teeming with marine life. Enjoy a five-course tasting menu featuring Maldivian lobster, fresh tuna, and exotic tropical desserts, paired with fine wines. Candlelight, soft music, and gliding fish create an unmatched honeymoon dining experience.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, Alimatha, South Ari Atoll

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk
experiences.description: After dark, walk along a secluded stretch of beach where the waves glow electric blue due to bioluminescent phytoplankton. A local naturalist guide leads the experience, explaining the rare natural phenomenon while you and your partner wade through glowing surf and stargaze under one of the world's least light-polluted skies. Includes a private beach picnic setup with tropical fruits and sparkling water.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class & Cultural Village Tour
experiences.description: Visit a local inhabited island to experience authentic Maldivian culture beyond the resort bubble. Tour a traditional fishing village, visit a centuries-old Friday mosque, and participate in a hands-on cooking class where a local family teaches you to prepare classic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and hedhikaa snacks. End with a shared meal and a short lesson in traditional Bodu Beru drumming.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. A dedicated Aegean Bliss Resort butler will greet you with a welcome garland and escort you to the private speedboat transfer. Enjoy a 45-minute scenic night transfer across the Indian Ocean with complimentary welcome drinks. Check in to your Beachfront Villa — savor a pre-arranged midnight welcome platter of tropical fruits, Maldivian sweets, and a bottle of chilled Champagne awaiting in your villa.

meals.breakfast: N/A (in-flight or pre-arrival)
meals.lunch: N/A (in-flight or pre-arrival)
meals.dinner: Private welcome platter and Champagne in villa, curated by Aegean Bliss Resort

day_by_day.notes: Given the 22:30 arrival, no formal activities are planned. The resort butler will ensure express check-in so you can settle in comfortably. Request a late breakfast for the following morning to recover from travel fatigue.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely late breakfast delivered via private in-villa dining on your overwater deck. Take your first morning stroll along the pristine beachfront, acclimatize to the turquoise lagoon, and get acquainted with the resort's facilities — infinity pool, spa, and water sports center. Meet your dedicated resort butler for a personalized orientation.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's private beach and lagoon. Take a complimentary snorkeling session directly from the beachfront to explore the house reef — spot colorful reef fish, sea turtles, and vibrant corals just meters from your villa. Alternatively, relax at the adults-only infinity pool with curated cocktails from the swim-up bar.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic sunset from your villa's private deck with a bottle of rosé. Head to the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant perched over the lagoon for a candlelit à la carte dinner featuring fresh Maldivian seafood and international cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Lavish in-villa private dining breakfast on your beachfront deck — freshly squeezed tropical juices, eggs Benedict, pastries, and tropical fruit platters
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's beachside grill — grilled lobster, fresh salads, and chilled coconut water
meals.dinner: Aegean Bliss Resort's signature overwater fine-dining restaurant — a 4-course seafood tasting menu with wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: This is a gentle acclimatization day. No off-resort excursions are scheduled to allow you to recover from travel and begin soaking in the paradise atmosphere.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — a guided half-day excursion departing at 08:00 by private boat to three of the Maldives' most vibrant coral gardens. Your expert marine biologist guide will introduce you to the diverse underwater ecosystem, including eagle rays, reef sharks, and kaleidoscopic coral formations. All premium snorkeling equipment provided.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by midday. Indulge in a luxurious couples' spa treatment at the Aegean Bliss overwater spa — choose from a traditional Maldivian coconut oil massage, a deep-tissue relaxation therapy, or a rejuvenating couples' ritual lasting 90 minutes. Post-spa, lounge by the pool with fresh juices.
day_by_day.evening: Dine at the resort's overwater bar and lounge for a casual yet elegant sunset cocktail hour, followed by a private beachside BBQ dinner arranged by your butler — freshly caught fish, lobster, and Maldivian curries grilled under the stars with tiki torch lighting.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — extensive spread of Asian and Western options, live egg station, fresh pastries
meals.lunch: Light post-snorkeling lunch on the boat — gourmet sandwiches, tropical fruits, and chilled beverages provided as part of the safari package
meals.dinner: Private beachside BBQ dinner arranged by your resort butler — whole grilled lobster, catch-of-the-day, Maldivian coconut curry, and a dessert of warm chocolate fondant

day_by_day.notes: Book the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari through the resort concierge at least one day in advance. Wear reef-safe sunscreen only — the resort provides complimentary reef-safe products. The snorkeling safari departs early, so a light pre-departure snack is recommended.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a sunrise yoga session on the beach or your private villa deck, led by the resort's resident yoga instructor at 06:30. Follow with a nourishing wellness breakfast. Spend the rest of the morning kayaking or stand-up paddleboarding in the calm lagoon waters — equipment available complimentarily from the water sports center.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take part in the Maldivian Cooking Class & Cultural Village Tour — visit a nearby local inhabited island to experience authentic Maldivian culture. Explore the village, visit a traditional fish market, and learn to prepare classic Maldivian dishes including mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya (fish broth), and coconut-based sweets with a local chef. Tour duration approximately 4 hours.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort in time for a relaxed evening. Enjoy pre-dinner cocktails at the overwater bar, then dine at the resort's Asian fusion restaurant — a curated menu of Japanese, Thai, and Indian Ocean-inspired dishes with premium sake and wine selection.

meals.breakfast: Wellness breakfast post-yoga — acai bowls, overnight oats, fresh tropical juices, avocado toast, and herbal teas
meals.lunch: Authentic Maldivian lunch prepared during the cooking class on the local island — mas huni, roshi flatbread, fresh coconut water, and traditional Maldivian sweets
meals.dinner: Asian fusion restaurant at Aegean Bliss Resort — wagyu beef tataki, miso-glazed black cod, prawn tempura, and matcha dessert with sake pairing

day_by_day.notes: The Cultural Village Tour offers a meaningful contrast to the luxury resort experience. Dress modestly for the local island visit (shoulders and knees covered out of respect). Photography is welcomed but always ask permission before photographing locals.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a completely free and unstructured morning — sleep in, order in-villa breakfast, and lounge on your private beachfront terrace. Take a leisurely swim in the villa's private plunge pool or the lagoon. This is your day to simply breathe, read, and exist in paradise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in a private snorkeling session guided exclusively for you by a resort marine expert — explore the resort's house reef in depth, with a focus on spotting sea turtles, octopuses, and rare nudibranch species. Alternatively, opt for a glass-bottom boat tour of the lagoon for a dry, equally mesmerizing experience.
day_by_day.evening: This evening, experience the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni boat decorated with tropical flowers and lanterns, exclusively for two. Sail into the golden Indian Ocean sunset with a personal attendant serving Moët & Chandon Champagne, canapés, and fresh strawberries. Watch for spinner dolphins frequently sighted during sunset hours.

meals.breakfast: Decadent in-villa private breakfast — freshly baked croissants, smoked salmon, eggs your way, tropical fruit platter, and freshly brewed specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Casual lunch at the resort's beach bar — gourmet lobster rolls, truffle fries, and fresh lime soda
meals.dinner: Return from the Dhoni Cruise and dine at the resort's premium à la carte restaurant — surf and turf menu featuring Australian Wagyu beef and butter-poached lobster tail, with a curated Bordeaux wine selection

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise is one of the most romantic experiences of the trip — ideal for a honeymoon moment. Request the crew to bring a personalized message or small gift for your partner through the butler in advance. Sunset is typically around 18:15–18:30 in March.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise fishing excursion — join a traditional Maldivian line-fishing trip with a local guide at 05:30 aboard a private dhoni. Experience the meditative art of traditional hand-line fishing as the sun rises over the Indian Ocean. Any catch can be brought back to the resort's chef to be prepared for your lunch.
day_by_day.afternoon: After returning from fishing, freshen up and enjoy a long, indulgent afternoon at the resort's world-class spa. Book a 2-hour 'Ocean Ritual' couples' treatment — a full-body exfoliation using Maldivian sea salt, followed by a hot stone massage and a floral bath drawn in your villa by your butler.
day_by_day.evening: Tonight, experience the extraordinary Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two — descend beneath the ocean surface to dine in one of the world's most iconic settings. Surrounded by the living reef and gliding marine life, enjoy a meticulously crafted 6-course tasting menu with sommelier-selected wine pairings. An unforgettable, once-in-a-lifetime romantic dining experience.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-fishing snack of energy bars and coffee provided on the boat; full breakfast served upon return — eggs Benedict, smoked fish, and fresh juices
meals.lunch: Your fresh catch of the day prepared by the resort chef to your preference — grilled with lemon butter, Maldivian spices, or in a coconut curry, served with steamed rice and salad
meals.dinner: Underwater Restaurant — 6-course gourmet tasting menu with wine pairing (reservation essential, book at least 3 days in advance)

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant Dinner is the most exclusive dining experience of the trip — advance booking is absolutely essential as seats are extremely limited. Smart casual dress code applies. The experience typically lasts 2.5–3 hours. Inform the restaurant of any dietary restrictions when booking.

day_by_day.morning: A leisurely mid-trip rest day. Sleep in, enjoy in-villa breakfast, and spend the morning at your private beachfront. Take a peaceful walk along the shoreline collecting shells. Optionally, visit the resort's library lounge for books, board games, and light refreshments.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a private dolphin-watching excursion — board a private speedboat at 14:00 and head to a nearby channel known for large pods of spinner dolphins. Snorkel alongside them in designated areas with your marine guide. The experience is exhilarating and deeply moving.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a relaxed evening. Enjoy a private stargazing session on the beach arranged by the resort — a telescope is set up by the astronomy-trained butler who guides you through the Southern Hemisphere's constellation map. End the evening with a nightcap of aged rum and chocolate truffles on your villa deck.

meals.breakfast: Indulgent in-villa breakfast — eggs royale, freshly baked pastries, tropical fruit, and a Maldivian-style coconut porridge
meals.lunch: Beachside picnic basket prepared by the resort chef — gourmet sandwiches, charcuterie, tropical fruits, and sparkling water served on the sand
meals.dinner: Intimate in-villa private dinner on your beachfront deck — a 3-course set menu of chilled gazpacho, pan-seared sea bass, and a decadent passion fruit soufflé, served by a personal butler

day_by_day.notes: The mid-trip day is intentionally kept relaxed. The stargazing session is best on a clear night — confirm with the butler in the afternoon. March skies in the Maldives are typically clear and offer spectacular star visibility.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on a second Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — this time focusing on a different set of reef sites, including a famous wreck dive-friendly snorkeling spot and a manta ray cleaning station where mantas are frequently observed between January and April. Departs at 07:30.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return by noon and spend the afternoon at the resort's infinity pool. Book a private mixology class at the pool bar — learn to craft three classic Maldivian-inspired cocktails using local ingredients like toddy palm, coconut, and tropical fruits, guided by the resort's head bartender.
day_by_day.evening: Attend the resort's weekly cultural performance evening — a traditional Boduberu drumming and dance show performed by local artists on the beach. Enjoy the performance with cocktails and canapés before transitioning to the main restaurant for a themed Maldivian feast night.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before departure — fresh fruit, yogurt parfait, granola, and strong coffee
meals.lunch: Post-safari light lunch at the resort's beach grill — fresh tuna tartare, grilled prawns, and coconut rice
meals.dinner: Maldivian Feast Night at the resort's main restaurant — a curated spread of traditional Maldivian dishes including garudhiya, mas riha (fish curry), bambukeylu bondibai (breadfruit curry), and coconut-based desserts

day_by_day.notes: Manta ray sightings are not guaranteed but are highly likely in March. The resort's marine biologist will brief you on responsible wildlife interaction guidelines. The cultural performance evening typically begins at 19:30 — arrive early for the best beachfront seating.

day_by_day.morning: Take a seaplane excursion to a remote sandbank for a private sandbank picnic breakfast — a truly exclusive Maldivian experience where you are the only two people on a tiny strip of white sand surrounded by the infinite turquoise ocean. Your butler arranges a gourmet breakfast hamper, chilled Champagne, and sun loungers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and enjoy a relaxed afternoon. Visit the resort's boutique for premium Maldivian souvenirs, local crafts, and luxury goods. Alternatively, enjoy a private snorkeling session at the house reef or simply lounge in your villa's private plunge pool.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk — after dark, walk along a secluded stretch of beach where waves glow electric blue due to bioluminescent phytoplankton. A naturalist guide accompanies you to explain the phenomenon. The experience is ethereal, romantic, and completely unique to tropical destinations like the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Private sandbank picnic breakfast — smoked salmon bagels, fresh tropical fruits, pain au chocolat, sparkling orange juice, and Champagne
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's overwater lounge — lobster bisque, Caesar salad, and iced herbal teas
meals.dinner: Romantic dinner at the resort's overwater fine-dining restaurant after the bioluminescent walk — a 4-course menu of scallop ceviche, truffle risotto, grilled barramundi, and a lychee panna cotta dessert

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank picnic must be booked 48 hours in advance through the butler. The Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk is weather and tide dependent — best experienced on a new moon night when the sky is darkest. Confirm the evening's conditions with the naturalist team in the afternoon.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a full morning of water sports — try jet skiing, wakeboarding, or parasailing over the crystal-clear lagoon, all available through the resort's premium water sports center. Alternatively, opt for a beginner's scuba diving introduction course with the resort's PADI-certified instructors in the calm lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's overwater spa for individual treatments — choose from a Maldivian herbal compress massage, a deep-sea mineral facial, or a reflexology session. Post-treatment, enjoy high tea at the resort's elegant lounge — finger sandwiches, scones with clotted cream, and premium teas.
day_by_day.evening: Tonight, enjoy a second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise — this time with a focus on night fishing after sunset. Transition from a romantic champagne cruise at golden hour to traditional Maldivian night fishing under a canopy of stars, guided by a local fisherman.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the main restaurant — wide selection of Asian and Western dishes, fresh pastries, and live cooking stations
meals.lunch: Overwater lounge high tea (serves as both lunch and afternoon snack) — finger sandwiches, warm scones, petit fours, and a curated selection of premium loose-leaf teas
meals.dinner: Catch from the night fishing trip prepared by the resort chef — grilled fresh fish with Maldivian spices, coconut rice, and a tropical fruit dessert, served on your private villa deck

day_by_day.notes: Scuba diving introduction courses must be booked in advance and include a full safety briefing. The night fishing experience after the Dhoni Cruise is a magical way to connect with local Maldivian fishing traditions — ask the guide to share stories of island life.

day_by_day.morning: A slow, indulgent morning — sleep in late and enjoy a luxurious in-villa breakfast. Spend time reflecting on the trip, journaling, or simply floating in your private plunge pool. Take a final long walk along the resort's beachfront to absorb every detail of this paradise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's photography studio for a professional couples' photo session on the beach and in the lagoon — a beautiful honeymoon keepsake. Alternatively, arrange a private snorkeling session at a newly explored section of the house reef with a marine biologist guide.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a private Champagne and caviar tasting arranged by the resort sommelier — an exclusive in-villa experience featuring three varieties of premium caviar (Oscietra, Sevruga, and Beluga) paired with vintage Champagne, blinis, and traditional accompaniments.

meals.breakfast: Ultimate luxury in-villa breakfast — lobster omelette, smoked salmon, freshly baked croissants, tropical fruit platter, freshly squeezed juices, and specialty pour-over coffee
meals.lunch: Light beachside lunch — sashimi platter, avocado salad, and chilled coconut water
meals.dinner: Resort's premium tasting menu restaurant — a chef's table 7-course dinner with full wine pairing, featuring the finest local and imported ingredients, prepared tableside for an interactive fine-dining experience

day_by_day.notes: The professional photography session should be booked 24 hours in advance. Request golden hour timing (approximately 17:30–18:15) for the most beautiful light. The caviar tasting experience is a premium add-on available through the resort concierge and should be booked at least 2 days ahead.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on a final morning snorkeling adventure — a private guided session to the most spectacular coral bommie near the resort, timed for the best underwater visibility. Spend time saying goodbye to the reef, the turtles, and the vibrant marine world that has become familiar over the past two weeks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend your last full afternoon luxuriating at the resort — a final spa treatment, a long swim in the infinity pool, and a leisurely walk through the resort's tropical gardens. Visit the resort's boutique to select final souvenirs and gifts. Arrange for your butler to prepare a special packing and luggage service.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate your final evening in the Maldives with a grand romantic dinner on the beach — a private table for two set directly on the sand at the water's edge, decorated with flowers, lanterns, and candles. A personal chef prepares a bespoke 5-course menu at a live cooking station, accompanied by a violinist and personalized Champagne toast.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely buffet breakfast at the main restaurant — take your time savoring every element of the resort's exceptional spread
meals.lunch: Final beachside lunch — grilled fresh catch, truffle pasta, and a shared dessert platter of Maldivian sweets and chocolate fondue
meals.dinner: Private beach dinner for two — bespoke 5-course chef's menu: chilled prawn cocktail, lobster bisque, wagyu beef tenderloin, pan-seared sea bass, and a showstopping chocolate and raspberry celebration dessert with sparklers

day_by_day.notes: Inform your butler of any final special requests for the farewell dinner — personalized menus, specific flowers, a handwritten note, or a surprise element for your partner can all be arranged. This dinner is the emotional highlight of the trip — allow plenty of time and avoid rushing.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up for one final sunrise on your beachfront villa deck — take it all in slowly with a cup of freshly brewed Maldivian coffee. Enjoy a final in-villa breakfast before your butler assists with luggage and check-out formalities. Take a last swim or dip in the Indian Ocean.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Your dedicated butler escorts you to the private speedboat transfer back to Velana International Airport. Arrive at the airport with ample time for your departure. Reflect on 13 extraordinary days in one of the world's most breathtaking destinations.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Velana International Airport — carry with you memories, photographs, and the deep sense of renewal that only a true paradise can offer.

meals.breakfast: Final in-villa private breakfast — a farewell spread of your favorite items from the past 13 days, curated by your butler
meals.lunch: Light refreshments at the airport lounge or on board your departing flight
meals.dinner: In-flight dining

day_by_day.notes: Request a late check-out (subject to availability) if your flight departs in the afternoon or evening — most luxury resorts accommodate this for premium guests. Ensure all souvenirs, resort keepsakes, and purchased items are properly packed. Exchange contact details with your butler and leave a gratuity as a gesture of appreciation for the exceptional personalized service received throughout the stay.
